summary: Register Ozon as the second read-only marketplace reference provider and prove that the existing Connector SDK product/inventory interfaces accommodate a materially different Seller API identity and pagination model without provider-specific Core changes.

impacts.evidence: Ozon account scope remains host-owned organization/workspace state; provider reads receive only validated Account binding and remote IDs while tenant persistence remains in existing forced-RLS repositories.
All committed fixtures are synthetic and bounded projections exclude credentials/raw remote errors; seller credentials remain scoped secret material.
Task 012 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP endpoint and changes no OpenAPI operation.
The connector is read-only and introduces no EventBus schema; Tasks 013/014 continue to own propagation and reconciliation evidence.
Ozon reuses the existing SDK-v1 ProductReader and InventoryReader interfaces introduced by the first reference connector; frozen Connector/Runtime roots and public capability semantics are unchanged.
Task 012 adds no migration; connector account, mapping, sync and reconciliation persistence already exists.
Ozon code has no direct network/database/filesystem/process/Core/App authority, obtains Client-Id/Api-Key only through scoped SecretAccessor callbacks and relies on Task-025/029 host isolation.
Manifest is read-only and declares no product, inventory, price or order mutation; future writes remain separate approval/risk-gated tasks.
Remote reads create no local business mutation; future sync writes retain existing audit/data-lineage obligations.
Ozon product ID, offer_id and warehouse identities remain remote mapping keys; opaque last_id pagination feeds existing Task-013/014 replay/drift semantics without provider identifiers entering Core.
Ozon transport is host-injected and production egress is limited to the official Seller API TLS host; provider sockets remain architecture-forbidden.
Health/auth/rate/service outcomes are normalized to bounded SDK states; production SLO thresholds remain Task 066.
Suspend the connector account or disable Ozon provider routing to stop reads; no database rollback is required because Task 012 adds no migration.
Synthetic semantic fixtures cover products/cursor/warehouses/FBS stock/error normalization and the canonical Task-064 report passes all thirteen mandatory checks including Linux isolation.
